_meta.description: RetroDojo chipset reference dataset. Stores SoC-level CPU, GPU, process, I/O, display, audio, storage, and power support details separately from device-level implementation notes.

reference_link_types.official_vendor: First-party vendor product page, brief, or datasheet.
reference_link_types.official_device: First-party handheld/device page that confirms SoC implementation details.
reference_link_types.third_party: Public third-party reference used when first-party SoC documentation is unavailable.

evidence_key.official: Official silicon vendor documentation or official device manufacturer specification page.
evidence_key.mixed: Official device page plus secondary vendor-ecosystem references; useful but not fully verified at SoC level.
evidence_key.limited: Public information is weak or incomplete; treat as provisional until official datasheet is available.
